title: WebView Completed open action flat cleanup
summary: Moved Completed open-action consumers from direct window aliases to mediaPipelineCompletedView and removed the requestCompletedOpen/renderCompletedOpenHistory flat compatibility exports.
reason: Continue the opportunistic WebView flat export cleanup while preserving backend-owned Completed open commands and command-history rendering.
behavior_before: Completed open action and command-history consumers could call requestCompletedOpen and renderCompletedOpenHistory as direct window.* aliases, and completedView.js exported both aliases in addition to the mediaPipelineCompletedView namespace.
behavior_after: Completed open action and command-history consumers call mediaPipelineCompletedView.requestCompletedOpen/renderCompletedOpenHistory; completedView.js keeps the namespace members and no longer publishes the two direct window aliases.
tests_added: Updated Completed/Pending proof browser smoke to require requestCompletedOpen/renderCompletedOpenHistory through mediaPipelineCompletedView and reject the removed flat assignments.
Updated command-history smoke to verify and call Completed open-history rendering through mediaPipelineCompletedView.
manual_validation: rg -n 'window\.(requestCompletedOpen|renderCompletedOpenHistory)\s*=' apps/desktop/webview/static tests Docs (expected no matches, rg exit 1)
rg -n 'window\.requestCompletedOpen|typeof renderCompletedOpenHistory|renderCompletedOpenHistory\(commandHistory\)' apps/desktop/webview/static tests (expected no matches, rg exit 1)
rollback_plan: Restore window.requestCompletedOpen and window.renderCompletedOpenHistory assignments in completedView.js, move rowOpenActions.js and commandHistory.js back to the flat globals, restore flat-global smoke assertions, regenerate WebView public contract and summaries, update the global export inventory/current-state count back to 574, and rerun the targeted WebView validation ladder.
notes: Flat export scanner now reports completedView.js=76 and total=572. This is WebView compatibility cleanup only: no backend route, command journal semantics, strict confirmation handling, Completed open allowlist, repair/reconcile apply, pending-publish drain, filesystem mutation, encoder/media policy, source media, or runtime state mutation changed. No downloads or real-media validation were needed for this slice.
